title: Bali Flight Inclusive Couple Escape | Island Tours & Adventure Experiences
highlights: Stay at premium 4-star properties at top-notch locations across Ubud & Kuta, thoughtfully selected for a comfortable & relaxing holiday experience.
Round-trip international flights to Bali are already included in the package, making your tropical island getaway smoother & completely hassle-free from the beginning.
No need to manage separate attraction bookings or activity tickets, as Bali’s most iconic experiences are already thoughtfully included throughout the journey.
From airport arrivals & hotel transfers to sightseeing tours & adventure activities, all major transfers are already pre-arranged for a completely trouble-less Bali holiday.
Complimentary lunches included during selected sightseeing & experiences allow you to enjoy Bali’s experiences without worrying about meal planning during the day.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Bali on a 7-day escape combining beaches, adventure, culture, wellness, and scenic landscapes. Begin in Kuta with time to relax at Vue Beach Club and discover local turtle conservation efforts. Get your adrenaline pumping at Tanjung Benoa with parasailing, jet skiing, and flyboarding, followed by a sunset visit to Uluwatu Temple and the traditional Kecak Fire Dance. Explore Nusa Penida by fast boat, visiting Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, and Bubu Beach with a snorkeling experience. Discover Kuta’s local markets and landmarks before heading to Ubud via Kintamani, Mount Batur viewpoints, Tegenungan Waterfall, a jungle swing, and Ubud Art Market. Enjoy a floating breakfast, explore Ubud’s art and culture, and end your journey with unforgettable Bali memories.

know_before_you_go: Carry a valid passport and required travel documents throughout the trip, as they may be needed during airport transfers, hotel check-in, and sightseeing.
Keep some Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) handy for small purchases, local snacks, tips, and expenses at places that may not accept cards.
Hotel check-in and check-out timings are subject to the property's policy, and early check-in or late check-out may incur additional charges.
The transfer from Ngurah Rai International Airport to Kuta depends on traffic conditions and may take longer during peak hours.
Water sports at Tanjung Benoa are subject to weather and sea conditions, and some activities may have age, height, or weight restrictions.
Follow the safety instructions provided by the water-sports operators and wear the required safety equipment during all activities.
Uluwatu Temple requires visitors to dress respectfully, and a sarong or appropriate covering may be required for temple entry.
Keep personal belongings secure around Uluwatu Temple, as monkeys in the area are known to grab loose items such as sunglasses, hats, and phones.
Please note that Floating Breakfast is included on Day 6 in your Private Pool Villa.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Kuta | Water Sports, Uluwatu Sunset Tour & Kecak Fire-Dance Show
days.desc: Today, set out for an action-packed day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, a popular spot for thrilling water adventures. Once there, enjoy activities such as parasailing over the turquoise waters, riding a jet ski across the waves, and trying flyboarding for an exciting experience above the sea. Later, get driven to the clifftop Uluwatu Temple & witness a beautiful sunset. As evening sets in, witness the traditional Kecak Fire Dance, a performance inspired by scenes from the Ramayana with fire displays.

days.title: Kuta | Nusa Penida West Island Tour with Snorkelling
days.desc: Today, get driven to Bali Port and board a fast boat to Nusa Penida, enjoying the scenic ride across the turquoise waters. Upon arrival, continue by transfer to Kelingking Beach, famous for its dramatic T-Rex-shaped cliff. Next, visit Angel’s Billabong, a natural rock pool framed by rugged coastal formations. Continue to Bubu Beach and enjoy a snorkeling experience in the island’s clear tropical waters, where colourful marine life and coral reefs add to the adventure.

days.title: Free Time in Kuta
days.desc: Spend a free day in Kuta. You can head out to explore Kuta and visit the Ground Zero Monument, a memorial that honours the victims of the Bali bombings. Also, you can visit the Kuta Theater and its entertainment offerings. You can continue to Kuta Square, a popular shopping and dining area known for its lively atmosphere. Later, you can experience the local evening vibe at Kuta Night Market, where you can browse stalls, shop for souvenirs, and sample local snacks and Balinese flavours.

days.title: Kintamani Tour | Transfer to Ubud
days.desc: Check-out and set out on a scenic Kintamani tour. Visit the Mount Batur Viewpoint and admire panoramic views of the volcanic landscape. Continue to a local coffee plantation to learn about Bali's coffee-making traditions. Later, visit Tegenungan Waterfall and enjoy the lush surroundings before experiencing the Bali Jungle Swing for an exciting photo. Explore the vibrant Ubud Art Market, where you can browse traditional handicrafts. Later, get driven to your hotel in Ubud and check in.

days.title: Free Time to Explore Ubud
days.desc: Start your day with a delightful floating breakfast, enjoying your meal from the comfort of your private pool. Later, spend the day at leisure exploring Ubud at your own pace. You can visit the Komaneka Fine Art Gallery to admire contemporary and traditional Balinese artworks, or explore the Setia Darma Masks & Puppets House, home to an impressive collection of traditional masks and puppets from Indonesia and beyond.

days.title: Ubud | Departure & Airport Transfer
days.desc: Today marks the end of your memorable Bali getaway. After checking out from your hotel, get driven to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward flight. As you bid farewell to the Island of Gods, take home cherished memories of beautiful beaches, breathtaking sunsets, thrilling adventures, scenic island experiences, cultural temples, lush tropical landscapes, and relaxing moments that made your Bali holiday truly special.
